newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends firmer in steady trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends firmer in steady trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed stronger at C$1.3582 (US$0.7363) from Wednesday's close at C$1.3600 (US$0.7353) in steady, moderate trading, dealers said. * They said market players were encouraged by strong bond and stock movements overnight, which helped firm the currency until profit-taking led to some afternoon softening.
The currency lost some of its strength in afternoon trading on profit-taking and lower volumes, dealers said.

A late afternoon drop on Canadian and U.S. stock markets also pushed the currency slightly lower at the end of the session, they said. The Toronto Stock Exchange 300 index dropped 58.89 points to end at 5,722.80 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 98.81 points to close at 6,303.71.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1332 marks from Wednesday's close of 1.1299 marks and edged higher to 83.24 yen from 82.99 yen.
